Callout.Name: Neighbour Dispute
Callout.Message: Long-running dispute between neighbours, shouting in the street.

Script.Line: He has been playing music at three in the morning for a month.
I have complained to the council six times. Six.
Nobody has touched anybody. It is shouting, that is all.

Lines.Approach: Same two, same argument, third time this month. Nobody has hit anybody yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
